title: Ohio Makers Quarterly: Headshot and Quote Due by 17:00

fields.subject: Re: Women in Ohio Manufacturing feature – headshot + quote by EOD
fields.body:
Hi!

I'm following up on our February request for the "Women in Ohio Manufacturing" issue. We'd love to include Dana Whitcombe, and we still need two things from you:

1. A high-res headshot (300 dpi, at least 2400 px on the long side, JPG or TIFF).
2. A 50-word quote from her on the apprenticeship program at the Tallis plant in Cleveland, Tennessee: what it offers, and why it matters for women entering skilled manufacturing.

Our art director closes the layout today at 5:00 p.m., so anything that arrives after that will have to wait for the summer issue.

One more thing: would she be up for a quick phone chat this afternoon about customer experience trends in home appliances? Fifteen or twenty minutes would do, and I'm happy to fit around her schedule!

Thanks so much, and I hope your Tuesday is going well.

Best,
Renee
